examples.title: Simple interest
examples.problem: Find the simple interest on ₹12,000 at 9% per annum for 2.5 years.

examples.title: Compound interest
examples.problem: Find the compound interest on ₹25,000 at 4% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually.

examples.title: Half-yearly and quarterly compounding
examples.problem: Find the compound interest on ₹20,000 for 1.5 years at 10% per annum, compounded half-yearly.
steps: The half-yearly rate is 5%, and 1.5 years is 3 periods.

examples.title: Compound interest against simple interest
examples.problem: Find the difference between the compound interest (compounded annually) and the simple interest on ₹8,000 for 2 years at 15% per annum.

examples.title: Equal instalments
examples.problem: A loan is repaid in two equal annual instalments of ₹6,615 at 5% per annum compound interest, the first at the end of year 1. How much was borrowed?
steps: Bring each instalment back to today: 6,615 ÷ 1.05 = 6,300 and 6,615 ÷ 1.1025 = 6,000.
